articleTitle: The Legend Of Zelda: Ocarina Of Time Remake Is Nintendo's Fastest-Selling Switch 2 Game Ever
summary: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time sold more than 5.2 million copies in four days following its November 5 launch, becoming the fastest-selling Nintendo-published Switch 2 game. The remake anchors Zelda's 40th anniversary celebration and ranks behind Mario Kart World, whose reported sales total is 16.48 million copies.​

coreControversy.corporateClaim: Nintendo reports that the remake is the fastest-selling Nintendo-published Nintendo Switch 2 game globally and in the U.S., Canada and Latin America, with over 5.2 million units sold in its first four days.
coreControversy.criticismOrAlarm: Launch-sales speed does not establish lifetime-sales leadership: Mario Kart World retains the higher published total of 16.48 million copies.
coreControversy.regulatoryOrHistoricalPrecedent: The remake revisits the 1998 Nintendo 64 original during Zelda's 40th anniversary celebration. Game Informer identifies Mario Kart 8 Deluxe as the best-selling game on the original Switch.

hiddenCatchesAndLimits: The sales-speed record is specifically for Nintendo-published Switch 2 games, not an established record covering every publisher.
The launch-sales figure comes from Nintendo's internal sales data and combines digital and physical sales.

The comparison uses different reporting periods: Ocarina of Time's first four days after November 5 versus Mario Kart World's 16.48 million and Donkey Kong Bananza's 5.05 million through September 30, 2026.
Overtaking Mario Kart World is a prospective possibility, not an accomplished sales milestone.
The remake is exclusive to Nintendo Switch 2.

avoidAdvice: Do not equate the fastest Nintendo-published launch with the highest lifetime sales or assume the four-day sales pace will persist.
Do not treat sales totals with different reporting cutoffs as a synchronized market comparison.
fitAdvice: The remake achieved more than 5.2 million sales in four days and a Nintendo-published Switch 2 launch-speed record.
Mario Kart World remains ahead in published lifetime sales at 16.48 million copies.
